title: State machine integration — AttackGuard/Sustain/Feedback wiring, CMakeLists
description:
Be the sole PerformanceStateMachine + PluginProcessor + CMakeLists.txt owner for phase D. Wire AttackGuard, FundamentalEstimator, SustainAnalyzer, and FeedbackDetector into the performance engine and processBlock path, and register new DSP/test sources.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/DSP/PerformanceStateMachine.* public API from phase C (transient/sustain/protection inputs, states, reopen)
- Source/DSP/AttackGuard.*, FundamentalEstimator.*, SustainAnalyzer.*, FeedbackDetector.* prepare/process APIs from d.1–d.3
- Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp phase-C detector → state machine → gain wiring
- Existing CMakeLists.txt target_sources / test patterns from phases A–C
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md sections 8–10 for intended control flow

PerformanceStateMachine integration:
- Accept AttackGuard validAttack / thresholdReduction (or open-assist score) to bias Primed/Attack/Reopen and temporarily lower effective T_open within max reduction clamps.
- Accept SustainAnalyzer S_sustain / sustainProtectionActive to hold Sustain state and extend release (pass adaptive tau_release_eff through to consumers or store last adaptive release for GainSmoother).
- Accept FeedbackDetector protectOpen / feedbackActive with safety already enforced in FeedbackDetector — machine must still honor protection end when feedback clears or safety ends.
- Keep dual-threshold hysteresis and 8-state semantics from phase C; do not flatten states.
- Realtime-safe process path only.

PluginProcessor wiring (realtime-safe):
- Members: AttackGuard, FundamentalEstimator, SustainAnalyzer, FeedbackDetector (plus existing DetectorEngine / PerformanceStateMachine / gain path).
- prepareToPlay: prepare all phase-D units at sample rate / max block size.
- processBlock order (conceptual):
  1) existing key/detector → L
  2) AttackGuard on key + L → validAttack / threshold assist
  3) FundamentalEstimator on key (control hop) → f0 snapshot
  4) SustainAnalyzer + FeedbackDetector from f0 + L (+ transient density)
  5) PerformanceStateMachine with L, attack, sustain, feedback protection
  6) existing GainComputer / GainSmoother using adaptive release when available
- Read APVTS AttackGuard/Sustain/Feedback params via ParameterIDs when present; else clear defaults. No editor/GUI work.

CMakeLists.txt (phase-D sole owner):
- Add AttackGuard.cpp, FundamentalEstimator.cpp, SustainAnalyzer.cpp, FeedbackDetector.cpp to the plugin/library target_sources
- Register tests/AttackGuardTests.cpp and tests/SustainTests.cpp on the existing test executable/target (bodies filled in d.5)
- Additive only — do not restructure unrelated targets or rewrite prior phase source lists beyond necessary additions

Do NOT implement test bodies (d.5). Do NOT reimplement DSP math inside PluginProcessor beyond calling the unit APIs.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: PerformanceStateMachine consumes AttackGuard attack/threshold-assist, SustainAnalyzer sustain score/protection, and FeedbackDetector protect/open signals
Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp construct and prepare AttackGuard, FundamentalEstimator, SustainAnalyzer, and FeedbackDetector
processBlock advances key/detector → AttackGuard → FundamentalEstimator → SustainAnalyzer/FeedbackDetector → PerformanceStateMachine before gain application
Adaptive release from SustainAnalyzer can influence release timing path (state machine and/or gain smoother inputs)
CMakeLists.txt lists AttackGuard.cpp, FundamentalEstimator.cpp, SustainAnalyzer.cpp, and FeedbackDetector.cpp on the plugin/library target
CMakeLists.txt registers tests/AttackGuardTests.cpp and tests/SustainTests.cpp on the test target
processBlock path performs no heap allocation attributable to this wiring

modify Source/DSP/FundamentalEstimator.* implementations except via includes/calls
